title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders: One Rider per Covered Person
content:
**Enrollment rule — Orthodontic Benefit Riders (Cascade Ortho Rider family).**

1. A subscriber may hold one orthodontic rider for each person who has a Cascade dental PPO enrollment under the subscriber. There is therefore no fixed cap on the number of riders per subscriber.
2. A person may have only one applied or active orthodontic rider at a time. The rider must be attached to that person's own dental enrollment, meaning the same enrollee name and the same date of birth.
3. All riders of the same subscriber on the same billing account carry the same rider plan.

## What the records must show

Whether a rider may be added is decided from the system records, before the rider is added, for the dental enrollment the new rider would be attached to:

- the enrollment must not already carry an orthodontic rider in applied or active status;
- the rider is tied to that dental enrollment, and the enrollment must be the person's own.

A rider that has ended (terminated or cancelled) on that dental enrollment does not count against the one-rider limit.

## Condition and result

| Records for the dental enrollment | New rider for that person |
|---|---|
| no rider in applied or active status | the one-rider limit is met |
| a rider in applied status | not added, because the person already has an open rider |
| a rider in active status | not added, because the person already has an open rider |

*Hypothetical household:* a subscriber with three children, each holding a Cascade dental PPO enrollment, may hold three riders, one attached to each child's own enrollment. If all three are funded by the same billing account, all three are the same rider plan.
